newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bombs blast Corsica tax offices, no one hurt.
newsitem.headline: Bombs blast Corsica tax offices, no one hurt.

text.p: Bombs damaged tax offices on the French Mediterranean island of Corsica overnight, but there were no injuries, police said on Saturday.

Explosions hit tax offices in the town of Bastia and the village of Ville di Pietrabugno and a powerful blast before dawn wrecked the post and tax office in the village of Migliacciaro on the east coast.
A powerful bomb also badly damaged the tax office in the northern town of Corte on Friday night.
The attacks bore the hallmarks of Corsican separatists who are waging a bombing campaign to demand more autonomy from France for the Mediterranean island.
